name: synth-forge
desc: Free, open-source local image generation studio for Windows — batch prompts, seeds, img2img. 100 MB portable, offline, MIT, no queue.
features: ✅ **Batch prompt runs** — a CSV of prompts and seeds generates overnight into an organized gallery
✅ **Style presets** — photographic, illustration and poster looks applied as prompt modifiers, editable
✅ **Image-to-image** — strength dial and denoise control take an existing image in a new direction
✅ **Seed control** — lock a seed to iterate one detail without losing the composition
✅ **VRAM-safe presets** — resolution and step budgets that fit common cards with an honest error when they do not
✅ **Gallery with metadata** — every output stores its prompt, seed and settings in a sidecar
✅ **100 MB self-contained exe** — runtime bundled, models download separately, offline after that, MIT
compare: | Price | **Free, MIT** | Free, OSS | Free, OSS | Free, OSS |
| Install weight | **100 MB exe** | Multi-GB Python env | Multi-GB Python env | Multi-GB download
| Batch from CSV | **Yes** | Scripted | Workflow | No |
| Node graphs to learn | **No** | No | Yes | No |
| Portable, no install | **Yes** | No | Partial | Partial
faqQ: lightweight local image generator for Windows without a Python setup?
faqA: The big open-source generators work, but they arrive as multi-gigabyte Python stacks that break on updates. synth-forge keeps the interface to a prompt box, style presets and a batch queue while models download separately. It is a 100 MB portable exe, MIT, offline, and the gallery keeps every setting in a sidecar.
s1: Dark forge (#121417, orange #F97316): prompt bar at top with style chips, generated grid of four images below, seed and step controls in the right rail.
s2: Batch CSV view: 60 prompt rows loaded with per-row thumbnails as they complete, progress at 22 of 60, overnight mode toggle lit.
s3: Image-to-image panel: source image preview, strength dial at 0.55, side-by-side result, metadata sidecar chip listing seed and sampler.
